author: Contributor 173
about: The Bot API page's examples and stated rules for the methods the telegram pack serves, made by Rui, a developer trying the page against his first bot (@rui_notes_bot): the Making requests example (GET, and a method name in another case), the HTML, MarkdownV2 and Markdown style blocks and their rules, a mention by id, an unsupported parse_mode, the text, update, webhook, chat action, deletion, album and photo rules (a file that is no image among them), each replayed as the answer or the refusal it causes. Setup steps make each example's precondition true (an account, the bot, his messages, a group with Marta, a channel) or read its effect back (the queue after a negative offset, after drop_pending_updates, after allowed_updates).

notReplayed.sendPhoto#doc sendPhoto: an HTTP URL: Telegram downloads the URL; a World is sealed, so the twin reaches no URL outside it and answers as Telegram does for a URL it cannot get (Bad Request: failed to get HTTP URL content); no World of this surface replays the success the page describes
notReplayed.sendPhoto#doc sendPhoto: 10 MB: a journey file carries its upload as base64: a file over the limit (10, 20 or 50 MB) would make the examples journey tens of megabytes; the rule is the twin's check of the upload's size, read in available-methods.ts and getFile
notReplayed.sendVideo#doc sendVideo: 50 MB: a journey file carries its upload as base64: a file over the limit (10, 20 or 50 MB) would make the examples journey tens of megabytes; the rule is the twin's check of the upload's size, read in available-methods.ts and getFile
notReplayed.sendDocument#doc sendDocument: 50 MB: a journey file carries its upload as base64: a file over the limit (10, 20 or 50 MB) would make the examples journey tens of megabytes; the rule is the twin's check of the upload's size, read in available-methods.ts and getFile
notReplayed.getFile#doc getFile: 20 MB: a journey file carries its upload as base64: a file over the limit (10, 20 or 50 MB) would make the examples journey tens of megabytes; the rule is the twin's check of the upload's size, read in available-methods.ts and getFile
